UMGC’s transfer rules

  • Up to 90 semester credits from other sources can count toward the 120-credit degree.
  • At least 30 semester credits must be completed at UMGC.

Source: UMGC 2026–2027 catalog: credit limits, associate and bachelor’s degree requirements (PDF pp. 26, 30, 35)

Pace used in this example

  • 2–4 completed outside courses per month is a planning assumption, not a provider promise.
  • 6–12 credits per university term is a planning assumption.
  • Outside providers are studied one after another in this scenario; overlapping study can change the elapsed time.
  • University loads use unit totals. Prerequisites, whole-course scheduling, start dates, breaks and registration availability can add time.
  • One-time university fees are included once; subtract charges you have already paid.

What this range leaves out

  • Uses the $499 out-of-state standard undergraduate rate, the rate for students who do not live in Maryland. Maryland residents pay $337 per credit ($343 from Summer 2027), and military students $250 with no technology fee; those rates are not applied.
  • Books and course materials, which vary by course, are not included.
  • UMGC runs fall, winter, spring and summer terms; 6–12 credits per term is a planning assumption.
  • Applicable sales tax on course subscriptions.
  • Books, supplies, course-specific charges and transcript charges when applicable.
  • Housing, meals, travel, health insurance and other living costs.
  • Rates are before financial aid, military benefits, scholarships, discounts and future price changes.
  • Completed or reported courses are excluded from new course charges; school acceptance of reported credit remains separate.
  • This is a range of known tuition, required university fees and selected outside-course charges, not a complete cost of attendance or a graduation-date promise.
  • Sophia uses the lowest published mix of monthly, four-month and annual memberships for the assumed study time. Prepaid plans require the upfront payment; promotions and tax are excluded.
  • 46 proposed outside units retain the eligibility conditions shown on their course rows.

Questions

Does Sophia Macroeconomics transfer to University of Maryland Global Campus?

Sophia publishes this match: Sophia Macroeconomics for ECON 201 Principles of Macroeconomics (or any ECON course) (3 semester credits). The match does not come from UMGC, so ask UMGC to confirm it before you pay for the course.

Does Sophia Microeconomics transfer to University of Maryland Global Campus?

Sophia publishes this match: Sophia Microeconomics for ECON 203 Principles of Microeconomics (or any ECON course) (3 semester credits). The match does not come from UMGC, so ask UMGC to confirm it before you pay for the course.

Does Sophia Introduction to Statistics transfer to University of Maryland Global Campus?

Sophia publishes this match: Sophia Introduction to Statistics for STAT 200 Introduction to Statistics (3 semester credits). The match does not come from UMGC, so ask UMGC to confirm it before you pay for the course.

How many credits can I transfer into University of Maryland Global Campus’s Bachelor of Science in Health Services Management?

UMGC’s published limit for this 120-credit degree is 90 semester credits from other sources. At least 30 semester credits must be completed at UMGC. This plan proposes 46 semester credits through outside courses.

Which courses must I take at University of Maryland Global Campus?

In this plan, 74 semester credits are taken at UMGC, including HMGT 305 Information Systems in Healthcare Organizations, ACCT 301 Accounting for Managers (or any ACCT course), BMGT 240 Building Sustainable Futures, BMGT 250 Data, Cybersecurity, and AI in Business Strategy, HMGT 300 Introduction to the U.S. Healthcare Sector and HMGT 307 Managerial Epidemiology and Decision-Making in Healthcare and 10 more. UMGC requires at least 30 semester credits at UMGC.

Can I choose my own courses in this plan?

Yes. 23 semester credits are open choices, such as Electives (remainder of the 45-credit general education and elective block), Communications: WRTG 111 or another writing course and Communications: a course in communication, writing, or speech. You pick a course UMGC allows, then ask UMGC to confirm it counts.

How much does this plan cost?

The planning estimate is $38,435 to $38,734 before aid. It covers tuition, listed fees and the outside courses in this plan. It is not a complete cost of attendance.

Has University of Maryland Global Campus confirmed this plan?

Not yet. Some course matches or open choices in this plan still need UMGC’s confirmation. Questions to ask: Some of the school’s published rules for this program are still being confirmed. Ask the school to confirm this plan before paying for outside courses. Ask the school: what is the most ACE- or NCCRS-recommended credit you accept toward this degree? Ask the school to confirm 10 proposed course matches for this exact program before paying for them. Pick a course for 11 open course choices in this plan, then ask the school to confirm they count. Admission and your transcript evaluation are always UMGC’s decisions.
